title: Tags in a note show in blue, the rest of the text in normal colour
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  • User B: a teammate at the same location to tag, who can sign in.
  • A work order at this location (customer for example "4 Star Truck Repair").
  • A tag group you own (for example "ZZ Pair").
  • A note on the work order: "Please check this @Tech ShopView and @ZZ Pair today" (tagging User B and the group).
custom_steps:
1. Read the note on the work order's Notes tab.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell in the top navigation (the Inbox tab). Read the same note as User B.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • @Dana Lee and @ZZ Pair are shown in blue.
  • All other words of the message are in the normal text color.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S2; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R13b: “In a note's message, tags (@people and @groups) are shown in blue. All other text is in the normal text color.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
